lines.t: The earth keeps turning
Day after day
The people go on living
Yet the veil remains
The rock is struck open
Living waters pour out
Flowing there before them
Still they choose the drought
Oh, the water keeps on flowing
Down the mountains, from the springs
Rivers spill beyond their banks
Yet their palates dry from thirst
Oh, the water keeps on flowing
And they never feel the drought
The last of their natural affection
Faded as their light went out
Why, why, why, ohhh
Lustful endeavors
Keep leading them away
And the night grows darker
With every passing day
The way of the Lord
They have not known
They give themselves to lust
And filthiness has made a home
Oh, the water keeps on flowing
Down the mountains, from the springs
Rivers spill beyond their banks
Yet their palates dry from thirst
Oh, the water keeps on flowing
And they never feel the drought
The last of their natural affection
Faded as their light went out
Darkness spreads across the land
Their hearts are growing cold
They open the door to wickedness
And give it full control
They have not known the way of life
They turn from waters that could heal their sight
Life rains down on hardened ground
Still they hold to what weighs them down
Oh, the water keeps on flowing
Down the mountains, from the springs
Rivers spill beyond their banks
Yet their palates dry from thirst
Oh, the water keeps on flowing
And they never feel the drought
The last of their natural affection
Faded as their light went out
Why, why, why, ohhh
